responsibility: This file provides GCC's core RTL jump utility routines and the cleanup_barriers pass. Although no longer a full jump-optimization pass, it is responsible for rebuilding JUMP_LABEL and label reference bookkeeping, maintaining label usage counts and REG_LABEL notes, redirecting and inverting jumps, comparing RTL under register renumbering, querying true hard-register identities, and normalizing BARRIER placement after non-fallthrough control flow. It is the shared low-level infrastructure for jump manipulation and label accounting used by many backend passes.
